bullets.id: Emas turun sekitar 0,5% pada Selasa setelah naik lebih dari 2% ke $3.954,41 pada Senin. Business Recorder mengutip analis KCM Trade bahwa emas masih dalam fase konsolidasi dan dijual untuk menutup kerugian serta margin call di pasar lain. Pada Rabu pagi, Trading Economics mencatat emas stabil di sekitar $3.938 sambil menunggu hasil pemilu sela AS dan perkembangan perundingan AS–Iran.
bullets.en: Gold fell about 0.5% on Tuesday after gaining more than 2% to $3,954.41 on Monday. Business Recorder quotes a KCM Trade analyst saying gold is still consolidating and being sold to cover losses and margin calls elsewhere. On Wednesday morning Trading Economics has gold steady near $3,938 as markets await US midterm results and news from US–Iran talks.

bullets.id: Hasil awal pemilu sela menunjukkan Demokrat unggul di sejumlah kursi kunci, dan Trading Economics mencatat indeks dolar turun sekitar 0,6% ke 101,3, terendah lima pekan. Brent turun ke sekitar $102,6, terendah empat pekan, dan yield 10 tahun AS sekitar 4,90%. Namun peluang kenaikan bunga Fed pada Desember naik ke sekitar 78%. Emas sekitar 29,8% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dan turun sekitar 4,9% dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: Early midterm results show Democrats gaining in several key races, and Trading Economics has the dollar index down about 0.6% at 101.3, a five-week low. Brent fell to around $102.6, a four-week low, and the US 10-year yield is around 4.90%. But the odds of a December Fed hike rose to about 78%. Gold is about 29.8% below its $5,608.35 record and down about 4.9% over the month.

bullets.id: FX Leaders mencatat resistance di $3.951 lalu $4.000 (sekitar 1,6% di atas harga kini), dengan EMA 50 di $4.023, serta support di $3.869 dan $3.828. Hari ini rilis ADP dan ISM jasa, Kamis klaim pengangguran mingguan, lalu payroll Oktober Jumat dengan perkiraan 68.000 pekerjaan setelah 29.000 pada September.
bullets.en: FX Leaders puts resistance at $3,951 then $4,000 (about 1.6% above the current price), with the 50 EMA at $4,023, and support at $3,869 and $3,828. ADP and ISM services are due today, weekly jobless claims on Thursday, then October payrolls on Friday, forecast at 68,000 jobs after 29,000 in September.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram turun Rp4.000 ke Rp2.537.000 dan buyback turun Rp4.000 ke Rp2.307.000, sehingga spread tetap Rp230.000 (sekitar 9,1%). Di Galeri 24, Galeri24 tercatat Rp2.467.000 (buyback Rp2.322.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS Rp2.496.000 (buyback Rp2.297.000, spread sekitar 8,0%). Harga jual Antam kini Rp70.000 di atas Galeri24 dan Rp41.000 di atas UBS.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp4,000 to Rp2,537,000 and buyback fell Rp4,000 to Rp2,307,000, so the spread holds at Rp230,000 (about 9.1%). At Galeri 24, Galeri24 is listed at Rp2,467,000 (buyback Rp2,322,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS at Rp2,496,000 (buyback Rp2,297,000, spread about 8.0%). Antam’s selling price is now Rp70,000 above Galeri24’s and Rp41,000 above UBS’s.
